# Blockly 11.2.1 (third-party)

Copied unchanged from the `blockly` npm package, version 11.2.1
(`https://unpkg.com/blockly@11.2.1/`), on 2026-11-24:

| File | Size |
|---|---|
| `blockly_compressed.js` | 922,025 bytes |
| `blocks_compressed.js` | 88,792 bytes |
| `javascript_compressed.js` | 56,352 bytes |
| `msg/en.js` | 32,824 bytes |

Blockly is Copyright Google LLC and licensed under the Apache License,
Version 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). The licence
headers inside the files are kept as they were.

It's stored here, not loaded from a CDN, because the drone's Wi-Fi has no
internet. To update, download the same four files for the new version and
check `blockly.html` still works against `?mock`.
